address: Passeig de Sant Pol 95, Sant Feliu de Guíxols, 17220, Spain
bio: This restaurant occupies an impressive setting in an old Modernist-style villa overlooking Sant Pol beach, as well as boasting a pleasant terrace that gets very busy in the evening. The traditional, maritime-inspired à la carte features top-notch fresh fish straight from the auction (sea bream, John Dory, grouper, sea bass etc), a few rice dishes and fideuàs. The extensive wine list has a particular penchant for wines from Burgundy....
